data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order: Flights tab, trip type, origin and destination, date, passengers, Search, Fastest, See flight, Select, Next. It covers the parameters well, but it treats 'direct only' and 'Flexible ticket' as fixed steps rather than parts of a general filters parameter, which may be overfitted. It is concrete enough to automate, though how the unlabeled clicks map to these steps is partly a guess.
